metadata.title: Triangles minimize the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue among planar bounded convex domains of a given area
metadata.abstract: We prove that triangles minimize the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue among bounded planar convex domains of a given area, thus resolving the two-dimensional case of Le's simplex conjecture for the Monge-Ampère eigenvalue (The eigenvalue problem for the Monge-Ampère operator on general bounded convex domains, Ann. Sc. Norm. Super. Pisa Cl. Sci. (5) 18 (2018)). The proof uses a neighbor-decreasing property of the Monge-Ampère eigenvalues of convex polygons along vertex elimination parallel chord movements.
metadata.comment: The main results of this paper were obtained through a series of chats with ChatGPT 6 Astra. The key strategies were obtained by ChatGPT. The author reworked and rewrote the article entirely
